How it works

Three steps. That’s it.

No site visits for a simple room, no hourly billing, no vague estimates.

01

Send a photo of the room

Use the quote form below, or text or WhatsApp me a photo of the room you want painted. A couple of angles and the room size help, but one clear photo is enough to start.

02

Get a fixed price in writing

You’ll get one exact price, confirmed in writing before your Saturday or Sunday is booked. The quoted price is the price you pay — no add-ons on the day.

03

Painted & cleaned in a day

I arrive on your booked day, protect the floors, prep, paint two coats, and clean up. You get your room back finished the same day.

Paint & materials

Paint is extra — here’s how it works

Package prices are labour only, so you never pay a markup on paint. Pick whichever option is easier for you; we’ll confirm it in writing with your quote.

You buy the paint

I’ll tell you exactly which paint to get and how much of it, so you can shop your preferred store or use paint you already have. Nothing is bought until the colour and finish are agreed.

I buy it — receipt on the bill

Prefer not to run to the store? I’ll pick up the paint and simply add the store receipt to your bill. No markup, no rounding — you pay what the paint actually cost.

Questions

Before you book

Is paint included in the price?

No — package prices are labour only, and paint is extra. You can buy the paint yourself (I’ll tell you exactly which paint and how much), or I’ll buy it and add the store receipt to the bill with no markup. Either way, it’s agreed in writing with your quote.

How long does one room take?

One day. A standard room — prep, two coats, and cleanup — is finished the same day it’s started, so you’re not living around a half-painted room all week. The Two-Room Weekend package takes one room on Saturday and the second on Sunday.

Do you give fixed quotes?

Yes. Send a photo of the room and you’ll get one fixed price confirmed in writing before your day is booked. The quoted price is the price you pay. Any extras — doors, repairs, a dark-to-light colour change — are quoted in writing before work starts, never added after.

Which areas do you cover?

Hamilton and Stoney Creek, plus nearby areas. If you’re just outside that range, message me with your location — if I can get to you on a weekend, I will.

When are you available?

Saturdays and Sundays only. Painting days book up in advance, so the sooner you send your photo, the better the choice of dates. Messages are answered during the week as well.
